description: Agent Knowledge: submit how a knowledge base handles corrections and versions, as the path is written, as the corrections made, or both: whether a correction path is written down (how a wrong entry is reported, checked and corrected), who corrects a wrong entry, whether earlier versions of a corrected entry stay reachable and where a correction lands (every place the entry is used, some of them, the entry alone or nowhere); and each correction with its id, the entry found wrong, when it was found wrong and when it was corrected, whether the wrong version stays reachable marked as corrected, and each place the entry is used with whether the correction replaced it there. The signed report gives the path, each correction with the places still using the wrong version, and the uses listed and left stale, and names corrections that do not hold: no written correction path, earlier versions lost, and corrections that land in the entry alone or nowhere or leave places still using the wrong version; then no owner, a path that reaches some places only and corrections with no dates, with the fix for each. How an agent memory store retires a fact a new one contradicts is wever_memory-conflict-check and two versions of one policy text are wever_terms-change-check. Verdict corrections_lost, correction_gaps, corrections_unverified or corrections_hold. POST /api/knowledge-update-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-knowledge-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-knowledge/.
